Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.draw

Enum Class NodeShape

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<NodeShape>
net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.draw.NodeShape
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<NodeShape>, Constable
public enum NodeShape extends Enum<NodeShape>
The shape of a node: how it is sized around its label and how it is drawn.

Smetana only knows boxes and ellipses: a DIAMOND is laid out as an ellipse of the same size, and the edges are clipped on the real outline by PlantUML (see hasOwnContour()).

    • draw

      public void draw(UGraphic ug, HColor fill, XDimension2D outer, int peripheries, boolean rounded, boolean diagonals)
      Draws the node outlines, the top-left corner of the node at the origin of ug, which carries the line color and the stroke. Only the inner outline is filled; with no periphery, only the fill is drawn.
      Parameters:
      fill - the fill color, or null for none
      outer - the size of the node, peripheries included
